description.en: Recurrent binge eating without regular compensatory behaviours, with marked distress
description.hi: नियमित क्षतिपूर्ति-व्यवहार के बिना बार-बार अतिभक्षण, महत्वपूर्ण कष्ट सहित

mappingNote: ICD-11 Binge-eating disorder is 6B82 within the 6B80-6B85 feeding/eating family (index 9.1.2, 9.2.2). DSM requires weekly binges for 3 months; ICD-11 frequency/duration requirements differ - assess each system independently.
